headline: Invitation Extended to Indian Mining Companies: Ethiopia | Invitation extended to Indian mining companies: Ethiopia
summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi met Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed Ali on the sidelines of the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi. Ethiopia extended an invitation to Indian mining companies.
why: Mining investment flows between emerging economies and critical-mineral producers shape supply of metals used in industry. Bilateral invitations like this can signal future project pipelines for Indian miners.
